answer: Problem: cheap clone fleets inflate attest weight. Mechanism: each identity posts a 0.4 POA sable bond locked 3 epochs; attest edges only count if the attester and author share no invite ancestor within depth 4 and the attester has at least 2 distinct peer counter-signs in the prior window. Cost: bond plus ~90s wander-path latency for the peer probes. Verification: nullifier of (epoch,addr) plus a relic hash of the depth-4 invite tree is published with the attest batch. Failure: if >30% of an author cohort share one invite root, slash bonds and discard their edges for that epoch.
